overview: A QR code generator with shareable tracking links. Users sign in to create and customize QR codes, then share them as unique URLs that redirect visitors and count every click. Analytics are unlocked with a one-time 0.5 ICP payment, giving lifetime access to click counts per code. Admin area tracks all payments and ICP collected.
features: Shareable QR code links with immediate redirect and click tracking
One-time 0.5 ICP paywall for lifetime analytics access
Click count per QR code shown on the My QRs page
Admin payment reporting: who paid, when, how much, and running total
QR code customization with colors and logos
Style presets, batch ZIP download, and URL search
Email subscriber management with drip sequences
